unresolved: The passage is cut off at their after describing a 100-page audit findings document for stores over 300,000 sessions; the continuation is missing.
Session volume threshold is inconsistent: the source says under 300,000 sessions and also under three thou 100,000 sessions; the period and exact number are unclear.
OCU and Zipify are not defined in the passage.
No Commerce and Komerse are not defined; Komerse may be a transcription of NoCommerce.
G4 is used instead of GA4; likely a transcription issue, but not resolved in the passage.
The source refers to bold non-negotiables, but the supplied text does not preserve bolding, so which items are bolded cannot be verified from the passage alone.
The source mentions a full comprehensive audit and an offer at the end, but the passage is incomplete.

Omitted units include the full comprehensive audit for over 300,000 sessions lasting two to three weeks and producing about a 100-page document; the under-300,000-session agency-or-DIY decision; the warning that important selling factors placed above the footer are seen by about 6% of the audience; and some detailed UX bug examples such as exit pops and cookie modals.
